systemicFinding: The v2 adapters encode narrow incidental page features (own subject keyword, education-only path, downloadable manual, selected-topic following h4) rather than reusable institutional source semantics. Generic reading/pageTask evidence meanwhile promotes broad navigation. Three substantive groups are correctly classified but ranked after these controls; ten remain semantically unsupported. This diagnosis does not prove every absent group reached collection or every static branch prediction executed.
architectureForNextVersion: Keep common privacy, visibility, source action/currentness, dangerous URL/handler authority. Replace page-label lists with explicit evidence kinds: explanatory panel, public preparation document, guided instruction, substantive document, actual service entry; service entry needs control pageTask rather than the present reading-only InstitutionEvidence shape.

Institution contracts should identify actual stable local source families/relationships. Own unfamiliar topic names must not repeat parent subject. Reuse bounded safe fixed heading/label and row/tab/panel evidence, never raw input/body dumps.

Rank provenance separately: current main-content document/operation versus local navigation versus global header/utility. Existing pageTask reading alone does not distinguish these, and category diversity alone fills first6 with navigation.

Readonly panel validation may inform narrow label-risk exceptions, but cannot bypass dangerous operation or form execution policy. Preserve locate for controls; do not reclassify payment/deletion/final-submit as reading to improve recall.

Keep all55pages development-only and compare generic/institution plus ranking change separately, with unchanged first6 and original thresholds. Freeze a later source version before another independent first evaluation.
